mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 65 degrees out at Harriet Park, and we have a lovely waxing crescent moon lighting up the sky.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers to help support their programs. Volunteers are asked to commit to at least two shifts per month and may need to assist with some physical tasks. Please note that you will need to sign a confidentiality agreement as part of the process.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today you can check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

In a report regarding service calls from August 3 to August 10, police noted that on August 5, officers successfully took a man into custody on Whalen Road after he attempted to flee from a probation violation warrant.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle. The shop is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
